Class Edges

java.lang.Object
imageproof.Edges
public class Edges extends Object
Sobel edge diagnostic.

For each pixel, using a 3 x 3 neighbourhood:

  • gx = (right column) - (left column), with weights 1, 2, 1
  • gy = (bottom row) - (top row), with weights 1, 2, 1
  • strength = sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy)

At the border, pixels outside the image use the nearest edge pixel (clamping), so a flat image gives 0 everywhere, borders included. Normal object outlines give strong edges. This is not a sign of editing. LocalAnomaly uses the per-tile values to explain tile boundaries.
